name: Odessia
notes: AI travel concierge that plans and books flights, hotels (including with rewards points), activities and full itineraries in one web conversation. Launched June 2026 in preview by Francis Davidson, co-founder of Sonder, with $6M led by Sequoia. Free to use, paid by booking commission. Web chat only; no messaging channel or app found. Requested via the form (issue #331).
tagline: An AI travel agent that plans and books the whole trip in one conversation

access.price: Free to use; commission on bookings
